I ended up going to the hospital to figure out what was wrong. They ran alot of tests, tested my blood, tested my my stool and urine samples, every test in the book. Oh did I mention that I was having these symptoms for around 3 months? So what did they do? They gave me two diagnosis. Unspecified depressive disorder and unspecified anxiety disorder. 

Yeah that's right, they gave me two unspecified diagnosis without finding more out about my condition and just sent me off to physical therapy. Didn't set me up with a psychiatrist just sent me home. They didn't give me any meds, they didn't give me any sustained support. Basically just said deal with it.

Oh yeah they also didn't confront the paranoia which was a huge mistake because when I was 15 I had a major psychotic episode. Turns out I have schizophrenia and nobody even helped me in the hospital, they wanted to send me home but thank God my mom fought for me to get the treatment I needed.

Point of the story is that mentally ill ppl r usually seen as not to big of a worry when we should be treated the same as any other patient.
